title: Kasteleyn faces and even spin structures
claim: Let H be a three-fold space (a connected 3-regular triple system that is not 2-colourable) whose glue is planar, so that its incidence graph B(H) decomposes along tight 3-edge cuts into Heawood graphs, doubled squares and planar braces. (1) Splice lemma: across a tight cut, if the contracted vertex lies on three distinct faces of each side's map, every genus-additive gluing has exactly three merged faces, each the union of one face from each side, every vertex still lies on three distinct faces, and the Kasteleyn face condition of the induced signings of the two sides gives the face condition for the signing of H. (2) Hence the knot's own (trivial) signing is a Kasteleyn signing of every minimal map of H: every face of every minimum-genus embedding of B(H) has length 2 mod 4. (3) For every perfect matching D, the Cimasoni-Reshetikhin quadratic form q_D of this Kasteleyn signing vanishes on the class of every difference of two perfect matchings (the signing is Pfaffian), so the Arf invariant of the spin structure does not depend on D. (4) The form splits as an orthogonal sum over the atoms; planar pieces contribute nothing, and on a genus-one piece the classes of nice cycles span homology, so the form has a nonzero zero pair and Arf invariant 0. So every spin structure induced by the knot's signing and a perfect matching is even, and its restriction to every Fano handle is even. (5) On the Fano space (the Heawood torus) the 24 perfect matchings induce exactly the three even spin structures of the torus, 8 each.
failure_conditions: A minimal map of a three-fold space with planar glue with a face of length 0 mod 4.
A gluing across a tight cut with other than three merged faces of one face from each side.
A perfect matching difference on which the quadratic form is 1, or a minimal map with Arf invariant 1.
A Heawood map on which the perfect matchings do not fall 8, 8, 8 into the three even classes.
foundation_claim_scope: Minimum-genus orientable embeddings of incidence graphs of three-fold spaces with planar glue and the knot's trivial signing; the spin structures are those attached by Cimasoni and Reshetikhin to a Kasteleyn orientation and a perfect matching. Non-planar glue is not covered here (ticket B computes it). No claim about non-minimal embeddings.

validation.status: checked: base pieces and the splice lemma on every minimal map of the 7- and 13-point spaces; the form well defined on every cycle-space element of the Fano space and on all classes of the 13-point space; Arf 0 and vanishing on matching differences on all 16 and 128 maps; the 8, 8, 8 split; controls fire; no human or external review
